value.body: Alliance Air is a government-owned regional airline — a subsidiary of AI Assets Holding Ltd, which stayed with the Government after Air India's privatisation. It flies regional and UDAN routes and recruits cabin crew through its own notices.

items.label: Fleet
items.note: 18 ATR 72-600, 2 ATR 42-600 and 1 Dornier 228, as on 31 March 2025
items.source: Alliance Air Aviation Ltd, Annual Report 2024-25

items.label: Staff strength
items.note: 852 employees as on 31 March 2025, all on fixed-term employment agreements; about 31% women
items.source: Alliance Air Aviation Ltd, Annual Report 2024-25

items.label: Average departures
items.note: Across 53 stations during FY 2024-25; about 12.8 lakh revenue passengers in the year
items.source: Alliance Air Aviation Ltd, Annual Report 2024-25

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 pass is the usual minimum, with age, height and medical standards stated in each notice; experienced-crew posts ask for prior flying experience. Selection includes a screening round, interview and medical, followed by the airline's own training.

value.title: At a glance
items: Openings are occasional and few at a time.
Contract terms and bonds differ by notice — read them carefully.
Being government-owned does not make crew posts permanent government jobs.
